annotations.annotation_text: Divisional threshold preceding Book IV (The Ricorso / Dawn, pages 593–628). Giambattista Vico's fourth phase—the ricorso—is not a static termination but a cosmic recirculation wherein human history, exhausted by democratic atomization, collapses back into divine primal nature to be reborn through the lightning bolt.
sources: Vico, Giambattista. The New Science (trans. Bergin and Fisch). Cornell University Press, 1948.
Verene, Donald Phillip. Vico and Joyce. State University of New York Press, 1987.
